items.q: How does it work? Do you recommend a psychologist for me?
items.a: You search our directory yourself by specialty and browse the full profile of every approved psychologist. Found someone who feels right? Just send a contact request from their profile — no middleman. If you'd rather, you can also fill out our short form describing what you're looking for; we'll let you know when we have someone matching that profile.

items.q: Do the psychologists work in Portuguese?
items.a: Yes. Every professional on our platform works in Brazilian Portuguese. Some also work in Spanish, English, or other languages.
Searching the directory and requesting contact is free. Each psychologist sets their own session price, shown on their profile when provided. We don't charge a platform fee on sessions.

items.q: What if I don't click with the professional?
items.a: No problem — and no obligation. You can go back to the directory and request contact with another psychologist whenever you like.

items.q: I'm a psychologist — how do I join the platform?
items.a: You create an account, set up your profile (specialties, format of care, session price), and once approved, you get a public page in our directory — plus scheduling, clinical records, and billing to organize your practice. See the plans under "For psychologists".

sobrePage.title: About
paragraphs: ConecPsi was built to give psychologists who work with Brazilians in Brazil and around the world an organized way to run their own practice — instead of relying on scattered spreadsheets, paper agendas, or a dozen disconnected tools.

The platform brings scheduling, clinical records, billing, and patient relationships together in one place, with the extra care mental health data requires: every clinical record stays isolated per professional, and no patient ever sees what isn't theirs. Anyone looking for therapy also finds a public directory to search and browse the profile of every approved professional.
We're still actively building the platform — new features ship regularly, always guided by what genuinely helps the people running a practice day to day.

termosPage.title: Terms of use
termosPage.draftNotice: This is a draft template, not yet reviewed by a lawyer. Before commercially launching the platform, we recommend it be adapted by a legal professional to applicable law and the company's actual registered entity.

sections.heading: 1. About these terms
sections.body: By creating an account and using ConecPsi, you agree to these terms of use. They apply to psychology professionals who use the platform to manage their practice, and to patients who access the patient area at their psychologist's invitation.

sections.heading: 2. What the platform offers
sections.body: Scheduling, electronic clinical records, financial tracking, and patient communication tools, organized into plans with different usage limits — described on the plans page.

sections.heading: 3. Professional responsibility
sections.body: ConecPsi is an administrative management tool. It does not replace the professional's clinical judgment and is not responsible for the content of the records entered, which are the sole responsibility of whoever creates them.

sections.heading: 4. Account and access
sections.body: Each professional is responsible for keeping their password confidential and for any activity on their account. Patient access is granted by the professional and can be revoked at any time.

sections.heading: 5. Cancellation
sections.body: You can close your account at any time from the platform settings. When cancelling a paid plan, access to the corresponding features remains until the end of the already-paid period.

sections.heading: 6. Changes to these terms
sections.body: We may update these terms from time to time. Material changes will be communicated by email or through a notice on the platform.

privacidadePage.title: Privacy policy
privacidadePage.draftNotice: This is a draft template, not yet reviewed by a lawyer. Before commercially launching the platform, we recommend it be adapted by a legal professional to applicable data protection law and the company's actual registered entity.

sections.heading: 1. What data we collect
sections.body: Account data (name, email, phone) from professionals and patients, and clinical data entered by the professional (records, session notes, scheduling, and financial information about appointments).

sections.heading: 2. How data is used
sections.body: Exclusively to operate the platform: authenticating access, displaying each professional's schedule and records, and letting patients see their own appointments and any notes the professional chooses to share.

sections.heading: 3. Isolation between professionals and patients
sections.body: Each professional can only access their own patients' data. Each patient can only access their own data — never another patient's, nor internal notes the professional hasn't explicitly marked as shareable. These rules are enforced directly in the database, not only on screen.

sections.heading: 4. Use of artificial intelligence
sections.body: The optional feature to summarize/organize notes with AI sends the note's text to an external AI provider (Groq) for processing. We chose a provider whose policy states it does not retain or train models on data submitted via API. This feature is only used when the professional explicitly triggers it.

sections.heading: 5. Storage
sections.body: Data is stored on Supabase infrastructure, with row-level access control (Row Level Security) enforced in the database.

sections.heading: 6. Your rights
sections.body: You can request correction or deletion of your account data at any time from the platform settings, or by contacting us.

general_tcle.title: Informed Consent Form
general_tcle.text:
INFORMED CONSENT FORM

This document formalizes your consent to begin psychological care on this platform, in accordance with professional ethics standards for psychologists (based on the Brazilian CFP Code of Ethics and Resolution CFP No. 001/2009, adaptable to local regulations).

1. Nature of the service: psychological care aims to promote mental health, self-knowledge and well-being through techniques recognized by Psychology. It does not replace medical or psychiatric treatment when that is required.

2. Professional confidentiality: information shared during care is protected by professional confidentiality. It may only be disclosed in exceptions provided by law (risk to life, court order, among others).

3. Clinical records: session notes are stored securely and are accessible only to the professional responsible for your care, for the minimum period required by professional regulation.

4. Voluntary participation: your participation is voluntary and you may discontinue care at any time, without penalty, by notifying the responsible professional.

5. Personal data processing: your data is processed in accordance with applicable data protection law and used exclusively to provide the contracted service.

By accepting this term, you declare that you have read and understood the information above and agree to begin psychological care on this platform.

[This text is a technical starting point and does not replace review by a licensed Psychology professional and, if necessary, a lawyer, before going live in production.]

online_therapy.title: Online Care Consent
online_therapy.text:
CONSENT FORM FOR ONLINE CARE (TELEPSYCHOLOGY)

In accordance with regulations governing psychological services delivered through remote communication technology (based on Brazilian CFP Resolution No. 011/2018), this term addresses the specific aspects of online care.

1. Format of care: sessions will be conducted by video call, remotely, using the tool indicated by the responsible professional.

2. Risks and limitations of the remote format: technical connection, audio or video failures may occasionally interrupt or affect a session. In such cases, the session may be rescheduled or resumed through another method agreed with the professional.

3. Environment and privacy: it is recommended that you take part in sessions in a private setting that preserves your confidentiality, avoiding the presence of unauthorized third parties.

4. Confidentiality in a digital environment: the professional adopts reasonable technical measures to protect information exchanged during online care. Even so, you should be aware that no digital communication medium is entirely free of risk.

5. Audio and video recording: sessions are not recorded, unless you give express and specific authorization for a defined purpose.

6. Professional registration: the responsible professional maintains (or is in the process of obtaining) the applicable professional registration for the modality of care offered, where required.

By accepting this term, you declare that you are aware of the particularities of online psychological care and agree to receive it through this modality.

[This text is a technical starting point and does not replace review by a licensed Psychology professional and, if necessary, a lawyer, before going live in production.]

guardian_authorization.title: Legal Guardian Authorization
guardian_authorization.text:
LEGAL GUARDIAN AUTHORIZATION

This term is addressed to the legal guardian of a minor patient, in accordance with applicable child and adolescent protection regulations and professional ethics standards for psychologists.

1. Authorization of care: by accepting this term, you declare that you are the legal guardian (parent, tutor, or designated responsible party) of the patient registered on this platform and you expressly authorize the start and continuation of psychological care.

2. Guardian involvement: you may be asked to take part in conversations with the responsible professional about the progress of care, respecting confidentiality boundaries appropriate to the minor's age and the professional's clinical judgment.

3. Confidentiality toward the minor patient: the professional may, within their technical and ethical judgment, withhold certain information shared by the patient in session when disclosure to the guardian would not serve the adolescent's best interest.

4. Revocation: you may revoke this authorization at any time by notifying the responsible professional, which will end the care relationship.

By accepting this term, you declare that you have read and understood the information above and authorize the psychological care of the minor patient on this platform.

[This text is a technical starting point and does not replace review by a licensed Psychology professional and, if necessary, a lawyer, before going live in production.]
